新增皮肤击杀音：盖亚的复仇、混沌序曲（参数设置→目标击中音效），1～5 杀逐级变: Added Gaia's Vengeance and Prelude to Chaos kill sounds (Settings → Target Hit Sounds). Sounds progress through kills 1–5, then repeat.
修复蹲拉时突然加速：按下蹲立即按蹲姿算移速和准度: Fixed sudden acceleration while crouch-peeking: crouched movement speed and accuracy now apply immediately when crouch is pressed
人物跟枪按部位计分：压头满分，压身体、腿算一半: Character Tracking now scores by hit location: full points for headshots, half for body or legs
收录全部玩家，可查自己的名次及前后各 10 名: Leaderboards now include every player. View your rank and the 10 players above and below you.
修复频繁重开冲纪录后成绩不进榜: Fixed results missing from leaderboards after frequent restarts when chasing records
「灵敏度调试」改名「灵敏度测试」，入口更醒目，开测前增加原理和测法说明: Sensitivity Tuning is now Sensitivity Test, with a more visible entry point and an explanation of the method before testing
个人中心新增「我的工位」，自动识别外设和电脑配置: Added My Setup to Profile, automatically detecting peripherals and PC specifications
修复桌面版隔一会儿自动暂停: Fixed the desktop app pausing automatically at intervals
旧版本打开会提示更新: Older versions now show an update prompt
瓦工坊上线排行榜，可以买枪买甲了: VALORANT Workshop leaderboards are live, with weapon and shield purchases
每个项目都有今日 / 本周 / 总榜: Each drill has Today / This Week / All-Time leaderboards
卡片上能看到有多少人打过、自己的名次，翻到背面能看前三名: Cards show player counts and your rank. Flip them over to see the top three.
名场面按通关用时排，其他项目按分数排: Iconic Moments rank by completion time; other drills rank by score

上榜成绩会经过系统复核，异常成绩会被撤下: Leaderboard results are verified by the system, and abnormal results are removed
每个瓦工坊项目都能查看自己打过的每一局: View every session you have played for each VALORANT Workshop drill
瓦工坊里按 B 打开购买菜单，可以换枪、买护甲（个别项目不开放）: Press B in VALORANT Workshop to open the Buy menu and change weapons or buy shields (unavailable in some drills)
血量改成 100 血 + 护甲，和游戏里一样；默认开局穿重甲，总共还是 150，: Health now uses 100 HP plus shields, matching the game. Heavy Shields are equipped by default, keeping the total at 150 and difficulty unchanged.
对局里的血量、护甲、弹药显示重新做了: Redesigned the in-session health, shield, and ammo displays
瓦工坊里每把枪都换上了各自的开枪声: Every VALORANT Workshop weapon now uses its own firing sound
修复：带奇乐大招「全面封锁」的场景，触发大招后回放存不下来的问题: Fixed replays failing to save after activating Killjoy's Lockdown in scenes containing the ultimate
